issues.desc: CHK-005 and CHK-006 both claim dispatch_watch, so runner-detail visibility vs scheduler-lifecycle visibility is not cleanly separated. Tighten CHK-005 to dispatch_status/runner artifact only, or make CHK-006 the sole dispatch_watch milestone, so item completion cannot be claimed without one canonical user-facing status surface.

CHK-006 and CHK-008 move the user flow to dispatch_auto, but the checklist never makes the migration/relationship to landed B-106b overflow_auto user-observable. Add an explicit acceptance clause for replace/alias/wrap behavior plus docs/smoke verification, otherwise users can finish with two competing entry points and no clear product closeout.

Checklist promises that watch/status will tell the user to retry, inspect, or stop a worker, but there is no explicit milestone or user-visible acceptance criteria for actually stopping/canceling a running unattended worker and seeing a final cancelled/stopped state. This leaves the user with observability but not a complete control loop when a worker hangs or runs the wrong task.
